How this is calculated

The listThree groups: the best Model Y options, new and used, with the extra row of seats and FSD-eligible hardware; the cheapest FSD-eligible Model 3s, used and new; then the Frontier PRO-4X picks. Jess Ford of Grand Coulee was removed Oct 29, 2026: the dealer has no Frontier.
The big numberOTD − resale, plus fuel costs if Fuel is on, plus repairs if Repairs is on, plus the FSD subscription if FSD is on; groups sort within themselves.
SortingPrice = big number, cheapest first, live; Year = newest first; Best deal = cost of ownership ÷ OTD buy, lowest first; Best car = editorial rating (age, miles, warranty, equipment, condition), scores hidden.
PricesActual listings from daily searches, verified on sellers’ own sites, not aggregators; CarMax includes its $1,999 transfer to Renton.
OTD buyFull out-the-door cost to a Seattle (98126) buyer: list + WA tax, title, registration, doc fees; new-Tesla figures are Tesla’s checkout estimates.
ResaleModeled, not quoted: one curve for all (~65% at 4y, 58% at 5y, ~28% at 14y+), mileage-adjusted, anchored per car, rounded to $50; optimism slider scales it −30% to +30%, capped at OTD.
Fuel toggleAdds fuel/electricity only (Frontier 18 mpg, Tesla 0.27 kWh/mi, $5.45/gal, $0.13/kWh; editable below).
Repairs toggleAdds expected, probability-weighted repairs (not worst case); costs rise past basic warranty (Frontier 3y/36k mi, Tesla 4y/50k mi).
FSDThe FSD toggle adds the subscription into Teslas’ big numbers when on; when off, the big number never includes FSD. Every Tesla here is a 2024+ car with FSD-capable hardware (HW4), and none has FSD paid: it can’t be bought outright on a new car anymore, so each is costed with the subscription layer: $99/mo ($1,188/yr, scales with Years; Y L charged one fewer year, first year bundled). When the toggle is off, that amount shows under the big number as “+ Nk fsd”; when the toggle is on it is already inside the big number, so the note is not shown.
Not countedInsurance, registration, maintenance, tires, Premium Connectivity ($99/yr), financing (figures are cash), home charger, parking, tolls, time.
VerifiedOct 29, 2026: Tesla.com, dealer listing pages, Cars.com; fuel averages EIA/AAA, late Oct 2026. Estimates for comparison, not quotes; listings change daily. Scale: AAA 2026 average new car $12,863/yr all-in.

Fuel averages used throughout: · . Edit either here and every figure recomputes.

Prices verified Oct 29, 2026. Tesla used-car links open Tesla’s used inventory: find each car by its VIN in the spec line.

Prices lead with estimated Seattle OTD; advertised price follows underneath. For new 2026 Nissans, the $4,500 Nissan Retail Customer Cash was already included in the advertised price for cash buyers and expired Nov 2, 2026; it could not be combined with NMAC 0% APR or special lease programs, and the Nissan of Everett 2026 truck (was $42,850) was removed from the board Nov 5 after confirmed dealer-site absence: the dealer VIN search returned 0 vehicles on Nov 4 and again Nov 5, its Cars.com listing disappeared Nov 3, and it was absent from Nissan USA Nov 5, so the new-truck segment is now empty. OTD math: advertised price × 1.1055 + $650. Green marks the best in a column. The bar is the 10-point deal score; tinted rows are stretches (over cap, far, or unverified), and a NEW tag marks today’s find. Tap a vehicle for its photos and full details; the source link opens the listing directly. Exterior photos are matched to the listing where possible; Frontier images marked MODEL REF are same-year, same-color PRO-4X references where the listing color is confirmed. Tacoma reference images are labeled with their actual model year. Cabin photos come from the listing where available; images marked CABIN REF use Frontier model-year references: 2022–24 and 2025–26.     Search criteria

    Frontier

    • Nissan Frontier PRO-4X Crew Cab 4WD, model year 2022 or newer — never PRO-X 2WD.
    • 2022–2024: Baja Storm. 2025–2026: Boulder Gray Pearl. Afterburn Orange excluded.
    • Price caps: used 2022–2024 under $35,000; used 2025–2026 under $37,000; new under $43,000.
    • Washington and Oregon preferred.

    Tacoma

    • Toyota Tacoma 2024 or newer, TRD Off-Road trim or higher.
    • Bronze Oxide or Mudbath, with Mudbath preferred. Non-light-grey seats preferred.
    • 14-inch infotainment screen verified from dash photos or specs — never inferred from package.
    • Price: $40,000 list or less with a verified screen; Mudbath with a verified screen under $47,000 OTD. Trucks within 10% of these lines are also shown.
    • Latest qualification pass: Oct 10, 2026, one live match. Dealer-site availability is required; third-party-only listings stay off the shortlist.

    Tesla

    • Model 3 or Model Y, model year 2024 or newer; AWD, Long Range RWD, or Performance only; base RWD excluded. Dark/black interior only (white seats excluded); under 50,000 miles; non-smoker when disclosed. Fully-paid FSD software, when verified, gets priority.
    • 2026-11-09: 11 cars, $35,799–$38,999. Tab set unchanged: six Tesla.com cuts: five Renton Model 3s (−$200 to −$600) and the Long Beach 7-seat (−$700, to $38,300); dealers all flat. No new qualifiers. Verified 7-seats: 1 (Long Beach only). FSD fully paid: 0 found (31st straight day) — every car on the tab is trial-only.
